d: Anyay ke viruddh larne vale har vyakti ko apni jan ki hani ka bhay satate rahta hai. mahamantri shaktar ka guptachar shishupal apni jan bachane ke lie mahamantri ke yahan sharan leta hai. udhar magadh ki praja par mahamantri ki jankari ke bina anek nae kar lad die gae hain . aur kar vasuli ke lie nae adhikariyon ki niyukti ka bhar mahamantri shaktar ke kandhon par lad diya gaya. kya shaktar is anyay ke viruddh apni aavaz uthaenge? kya hoga magadh ke raja dhannand ka agla kadam - dekhie chanaky ke is episod men - On Official Chanakya
